name: apimatic
description: APIMatic plugin marketplace — SDK-native, version-aware API context for your AI coding agent.

plugins.name: context-matic
plugins.description: Deterministic, version-aware API and SDK context for third-party APIs, delivered directly into your coding agent.

plugins.name: acp-paypal
plugins.description: Integrate and debug PayPal APIs using the acp-paypal MCP server.

plugins.name: maxio-plugin
plugins.description: Plan and debug Maxio Advanced Billing .NET SDK integrations with maxio-plan and maxio-debug agents, grounded in bundled Maxio SDK skills and the cloned SDK source. No MCP server.

plugins.name: maxio-sdk
plugins.description: Install and consume the Maxio Advanced Billing .NET SDK with skill-only guidance plus a bundled SDK map — the agent looks up signatures, errors, enums, and unions in the map and opens only the exact source file it needs in the cloned SDK, instead of grepping. No MCP server.

plugins.name: maxio-sdk-exp1-agents
plugins.description: EXPERIMENTAL variant of maxio-sdk adding subagent orchestration (integrate-maxio router + maxio-plan contract-sheet agent + maxio-debug escalation-first agent) on top of the identical map/skills data layer. dev-raw only; not for production install.
